note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The sample shows both runs of one test: the design on 2026-09-03 (it used only the 12 baseline weeks) and the read-out on 2026-10-28.

request.design: Hey Claude, I just added the "seo-split-test" skill. We have about 50 'booking software for <business type>' pages under /booking-software/. We want to add 'deposits and SMS reminders' to their titles. Design a test so we know if it helps. Even an 8% lift in clicks would be worth it.
request.read_out: The test you designed has run its planned weeks. Read it. One thing: we rewrote the intro on the driving instructors page on 2026-09-29 for a partner campaign.

account.business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)

change.before_template: Online booking software for <business type> | Example Booking Software
change.after_template: Booking software for <business type> with deposits and SMS reminders

pull_1_search_console_daily_by_page.shape: daily rows summed into Monday to Sunday weeks; position is impression-weighted per week
